The filename count ('full30') is stale; the authoritative section count is carried by schema_version ('modeb_corrective_full48_v1') and the sections[] list below, which define the §1–§48 finished-deliverable contract. When filename and schema_version disagree, schema_version wins. Do not read '30' from the filename as a section ceiling. A physical rename is deferred because code and tests bind to this name; see docs/CURRENT_DOCS_INDEX.md for the canonical section doc.
section_policy: Expanded publication-candidate profile requires §1–§48 in exact order. A section may contain a reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE disposition, but it may not be omitted. LLMs must not invent, rename, reorder, or substitute section titles. Legacy conditional/optional flags remain only for backward-compatible non-publication linting.

artifact_drift_policy.evidence_tables: supporting appendix/index only; never a substitute for the card body
artifact_drift_policy.bulk_scaling: one BGC must pass the quality gate before all-BGC scaling
artifact_drift_policy.pdf_export: PDF/export is downstream packaging after Markdown/card text passes the gate
artifact_drift_policy.character_counts: progress metadata only; never acceptance evidence
artifact_drift_policy.blastp_hmmer: belongs in section 16 or appendices, not section 7

sections.title: Core biosynthetic logic
sub_questions: Committed-step audit: is the class's committed/necessary gateway enzyme actually present (per the class-believability engine, LQ-PATH-01), or is this the named false-positive superfamily the class label over-calls into?
Minimal-gene-set completeness: is the minimal gene set for this scaffold complete ON THIS CONTIG, or is a core piece most likely an off-contig fragment (fragmentation — cross-check RG-GMCI)?

sections.title: Alternative hypotheses
sub_questions: Named-FP alternative: state the specific superfamily / primary-metabolism mis-call this class label is prone to (from the registry / LQ-PATH-01), and weigh it explicitly.
Fragment alternative: is the more parsimonious reading that this region is a FRAGMENT of a larger known pathway captured mid-cluster? Weigh against RG-GMCI (4A_*).

sections.title: Antibacterial/antifungal relevance
sub_questions: Class in Actinobacteria: how common / characterized is this compound CLASS among actinobacterial natural products? (NP Atlas npclassifier class-frequency, LQ-NPATLAS-01 — organism-independent, aggregate only.)

Class in this genus: what is reported for this class in this genus? — tagged `inferred`/`assumed` and grounded in literature, NOT asserted from NP Atlas isolation provenance (which records origin, not taxonomic distribution).

quality_gate: Every first BGC mention includes node/region.
Expanded owner-review candidates contain §1–§48 in exact order; reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE replaces omission.
Every conditional §21–§27 / §29 that applies to this BGC is present.
Section 4 contains prose interpretation, not only tables.
Important genes include protein_length_aa where available.
Section 4 contains one contiguous named-match table with exactly one row per independently supplied canonical displayed gene.
Sections 5–7 satisfy the explicit scientific-reasoning scaffold; character counts are diagnostics only.
Every section §1–§48 has a completeness row naming evidence and predecessor-content disposition.
All 14 supporting streams have typed dispositions and historical content loss is reconciled explicitly.
Comparator/KCB is treated as similarity, not identity.
At least two plausible alternative interpretations are named when evidence permits.
The next experiment or analysis is specific.
A scientist can understand the BGC without opening the CSV.
Every first BGC mention uses the four-field display: strain / full node-or-contig / region / BGC alias.
Character counts are progress metadata only; never acceptance evidence.
Mechanical validation cannot claim release or publication readiness (cap: EVIDENCE_MATRIX_VALIDATED).
